rationale: No supported optimization applies safely. Dependency caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) is already implemented via actions/cache@v4 with a lockfile-keyed npm cache. The measured P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT evidence applies timeout-minutes: 5 to a fast Ubuntu Node.js workflow (median ~41s elapsed), but this job runs on macos-15 and runs `make test-all` (CDK synth across all patterns) with no available duration history; imposing a short timeout risks the pattern's contraindication that valid slow runs may exceed the limit, and no evidence supports a specific safe budget for this workload. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST offers no benefit with a single matrix value; P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE and P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE require scheduled triggers which are absent; Bazel and test-selection patterns do not fit the Makefile/CDK steps.
